case_title: BRAHM SWAROOP & ANR. v. STATE OF U.P.
statutory_provisions: IPC s.302, s.34; Arms Act s.25
trial_court_outcome: Accused Nos. 2 and 3 convicted under s. 302/34 IPC, death sentence; Accused Nos. 1 and 4 convicted under s. 302/34 and 307/34 IPC, life imprisonment; Accused Nos. 5 and 6 acquitted
high_court_outcome: High Court confirmed conviction of accused Nos. 5 and 6 under s. 302/34 and 307/34 IPC, life imprisonment; upheld acquittal under s. 25 Arms Act
neutral_facts: The accused were involved in an incident where four persons died. The prosecution alleged that the accused surrounded the deceased and fired at them with weapons. Deceased No. 1 died immediately, while others sustained serious injuries and later succumbed to their injuries. The trial court acquitted two accused of all charges but convicted others. The High Court reversed the acquittal of two accused and convicted them for the murders. The evidence included eyewitness accounts, medical reports, and recovered weapons. The accused were involved in a confrontation that resulted in multiple deaths, with the prosecution presenting credible evidence of their participation in the incident.
